Over-dose Warning
I have quite a bit of experience with all categories of drugs, psychedelics and dissociatives being among my favorites. I am familiar with large doses of Ketamine and DXM, as well as medium/large doses of this drug. Despite all of my drug use, this is the first time I felt the need to make an experience report, as a warning.
I usually take about 120mg of this stuff to have a nice, somewhat strong experience (dosing this drug is tricky; peoples sensitivity varies a lot). I think its somewhat similar to DXM, obviously easier to ingest and digest though, which I like.
The days prior to this I had gone through a few grams of ketamine so I figured I had some cross-tolerance, so I decided to dose 150mg. About 1.5 hours later (this drug takes a full hour to start kicking in for me) I wasnt satisfied with the effects so I decided to take another 300mg, thinking I had an enormous tolerance from all the ketamine, also thinking the worst that would happen is Id pass out. I was on my bed, surfing the internet for another half hour and the next thing I know Im in an ambulance and all the sudden in a hospital bed where I ended up ripping the IVs out of my arm, twice. Apparently, (at 3am mind you) my dad woke up to me crashing into walls and furniture breaking things, unable to communicate.  He found me wandering down the road, which is when he decided to call the ambulance as he didnt know what I took or what might happen to me. I ended up spending the next day in the hospital missing work.
This is a warning. Over-dosing is a dangerous thing with this drug and caution should be taken. I read that redosing should be avoided as it puts you at greater risk of amnesia. Not a bad drug but always keep it under 150mg!
